status: Registered before generating or evaluating a canonical field on the new development interaction.

supersedes.reason: v1 applied Adam weight decay 0.01 to a likelihood with mean scale about 3e-6, collapsing every fitted coefficient to about 1e-5. A fit-only gradient diagnostic with no validation access confirmed that the differentiable basis moves and lowers fit loss when this scale mismatch is removed. V1 remains a failed immutable result.

claim_boundary: This is a future-blind model-family test on previously examined released prefixes. Passing can admit an exploratory future run, but cannot establish an independent state-of-the-art claim.

development_case.name: double_lift_sloth
development_case.role: Fresh canonical-field competence gate; no v1 canonical-field result exists for this interaction; excluded from source-transfer acceptance.

evidence_boundary.validation_interval: remaining 25 percent of the released observation prefix
evidence_boundary.future_controller_values: omitted beyond each prefix artifact boundary
evidence_boundary.future_metrics: sealed unless every source gate passes

method.teacher: released PhysTwin graph and per-edge spring field
method.parameterization: additive rank-16 normalized Gaussian-RBF log-stiffness field over canonical object-spring midpoints, plus one separate controller-spring coefficient
method.regularization_boundary: smoothness and capacity are supplied by the normalized rank-16 RBF field; no optimizer-scale-dependent L2 penalty is used
method.selection_metric: equal mean of validation Chamfer-distance and manual-track-error ratios

development_competence_gate.reference: zero-update exact-teacher trajectory from the same canonical-basis runner

source_acceptance.aggregate_requirement: equal-case selected stack improves both validation Chamfer distance and manual-track error
source_acceptance.fallback: reject the complete family and retain the exact teacher
